entity.summary: British Virgin Islands-registered centralized cryptocurrency exchange offering spot, futures, earn, launchpad, payment, and related trading services under the Biconomy.com brand.
entity.notes: Current first-party company material identifies BICONOMY PTE. LTD and a British Virgin Islands address and exposes active exchange products. Current independent exchange data lists hundreds of recently updated spot markets, substantial non-zero volume, reserves, and the same jurisdiction. This record is the exchange platform, not the unrelated Biconomy Web3 infrastructure protocol. No unsupported exact launch date, predecessor, successor, terminal state, or incident event is asserted.
